/**
 * {{targetName}} controller spec — generated by the Wheels CLI.
 *
 * This is code you own — extend it as your actions grow. Run with
 * `wheels test` after `wheels migrate latest`.
 *
 * Test data: beforeEach persists a record with model().create(properties=...).
 * That is the Wheels-native stand-in for Rails YAML fixtures — there is no
 * separate fixture file. WheelsTest + processRequest(csrf="ignore" by default)
 * exercise the seven CRUD actions the way Rails' *_controller_test.rb does.
 */
component extends="wheels.WheelsTest" {

	function run() {

		describe("{{targetName}} controller", () => {

			beforeEach(() => {
				{{belongsToSetup}}
				variables.{{modelNameLower}} = model("{{modelName}}").create(properties = {{validAttributes}});
			});

			it("renders the index page", () => {
				var result = processRequest(params = {controller = "{{targetName}}", action = "index"}, method = "get", returnAs = "struct");
				expect(result.status).toBe(200);
			});

			it("renders the new page", () => {
				var result = processRequest(params = {controller = "{{targetName}}", action = "new"}, method = "get", returnAs = "struct");
				expect(result.status).toBe(200);
			});

			it("creates a record", () => {
				var beforeCount = model("{{modelName}}").count();
				var result = processRequest(
					params = {controller = "{{targetName}}", action = "create", {{modelNameLower}} = {{validAttributes}}},
					method = "post",
					returnAs = "struct"
				);
				expect(result.status).toBe(303);
				expect(len(result.redirect)).toBeGT(0);
				expect(model("{{modelName}}").count()).toBe(beforeCount + 1);
			});

			it("renders the show page", () => {
				var result = processRequest(params = {controller = "{{targetName}}", action = "show", key = variables.{{modelNameLower}}.id}, method = "get", returnAs = "struct");
				expect(result.status).toBe(200);
			});

			it("renders the edit page", () => {
				var result = processRequest(params = {controller = "{{targetName}}", action = "edit", key = variables.{{modelNameLower}}.id}, method = "get", returnAs = "struct");
				expect(result.status).toBe(200);
			});

			it("updates a record", () => {
				var result = processRequest(
					params = {controller = "{{targetName}}", action = "update", key = variables.{{modelNameLower}}.id, {{modelNameLower}} = {{validAttributes}}},
					method = "post",
					returnAs = "struct"
				);
				expect(result.status).toBe(303);
				expect(len(result.redirect)).toBeGT(0);
			});

			it("deletes a record", () => {
				var beforeCount = model("{{modelName}}").count();
				var result = processRequest(
					params = {controller = "{{targetName}}", action = "delete", key = variables.{{modelNameLower}}.id},
					method = "delete",
					returnAs = "struct"
				);
				expect(result.status).toBe(303);
				expect(len(result.redirect)).toBeGT(0);
				expect(model("{{modelName}}").count()).toBe(beforeCount - 1);
			});

		});

	}

}
